blurb: Skydive Spaceland Houston offers skydiving experiences including tandem jumps and training for experienced skydivers. The facility provides gear rental, rigging services, and on-site camping and lodging. They operate daily with a focus on safety and organized jump events.
extraNote: Manifest open every day except Thanksgiving afternoon and Christmas · Put money on account before jumping or buy jump tickets online · Pulling from a load after the 10-minute call results in loss of jump ticket · No night jumps, high pulls, or cross-country jumps on rental gear · All rental gear must be packed by staff packers after last jump of the day · No smoking in rental gear or jumpsuits

quotes.author: Cinthia Olsen
quotes.text: Amazing experience, great people had my first tandem jump with Vivis and had Adriana as my photographer I loved the experience and sharing it with them! I purchased my second flight already can’t wait to go back!!

quotes.author: Donesha Louis
quotes.text: This was my third time skydiving, and clearly I have a problem because I LOVED it 😭🔥 🪂. From start to finish, everything was smooth, organized, and very professional. My instructor Pipe was that guy cool, calm, and clearly unfazed while I’m mentally questioning my life choices mid-air 😂. He kept the vibes right, made me feel safe, and still had me laughing and hype the whole time. Overall, 10/10 experience. If jumping out of a perfectly good plane is on your bucket list… this is the place. I’d absolutely do it again.

quotes.author: Elmer Bonilla
quotes.text: I did my skydiving training with Eren, and she truly went above and beyond. She was patient, professional, and always made sure I felt confident and safe throughout the entire process. I also completed my tandem jumps with Carlitos and Adri, and both were awesome—very professional and made every jump an incredible experience. Amazing team and an unforgettable experience. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Ameer Bilbesi
quotes.text: This was my first time parachuting, and the entire experience was incredibly smooth from start to finish. Kevin was very clear, professional, and guided me step by step, which made me feel comfortable and confident the whole time. It was truly an amazing experience, and I couldn’t have asked for a better first jump. Highly recommend!

I had my first skydiving experience today and it was the most terrifying yet the most beautiful thing I have ever experienced. My instructor, Carlos, made me feel comfortable and was extremely professional. He made my experience as a first timer, so much fun. I highly recommend coming here if it's your first or 100th jump. Amazing!

quotes.author: Scot Fitzgerald
quotes.text: The instructors push you to perform at your best. Everyone there treats you like you are a part of the family. I feel like the skydiving experience speaks for itself. If you’ve always wanted to jump you should go here.
